composers.name: Enric Morera i Viura
composers.why: Wikidata: Catalan composer, born 22 May 1865, as in the article. IMSLP has the same dates, lists "Enric (Enrique) Morera i Viura" and the same VIAF cluster (44491201). GND, LoC and BnF all give 1942; the day differs (11 or 12 March), which does not matter. The GND search also returns a namesake born 1959: choose the record by dates and occupation. The Identifiers section of the Wikidata page links GND, LoC, BnF and VIAF; cite the record you opened, not Wikidata.

composers.name: Ernestina Lecuona y Casado

worked.notes: No dates in GND or LoC; Wikipedia, Wikidata and IMSLP agree on 3 Sep 1951.

composers.why: IMSLP files her under the first surname only (Spanish double surname); the category lists "Lecuona y Casado" as an alternate name, the same dates and the same Wikidata item. Category:Lecuona,_Ernesto is her brother. GND has no record and LoC one without dates, so the date comes from level 2: the Dictionnaire universel des créatrices, which cites the New Grove Dictionary of Women Composers.

works.work_id: Suite for 2 Violins and Small Orchestra, Op.15 (Zilcher, Hermann)
works.title: Suite for 2 Violins and Small Orchestra, Op.15
works.why: The original is two soloists with orchestra. The only files are a version for 2 violins and piano under Arrangements and Transcriptions; judge the original, and even a composer's own chamber version (7) loses to concerto (9). Arrangement files still count for has_files. No category is a rights category (Sibley Mirroring Project is a scan source).

works.title: Caprice No.2
works.why: Violin alone. A complete score (PWM, 1952) is on the page. The category list has WorkNonPD-USandEU; the file's "Copyright: Public Domain" line is IMSLP's Canadian status, and the basis comes from the categories.
